instructions: A reviewer raised this finding and did not call it blocking. The builder then fixed it and says what each change touched; one entry may also cover other findings. Must the reviewer look at this fix again before the work is committed? Judge each entry by its change line. Answer yes when any entry changes logic at a spot the finding did not name, changes a config default or what a gate accepts, changes shared test helpers or fixtures the finding did not ask for, or changes an interface: a signature, a CLI option or its help text, a schema, a prompt, or an agent rule or skill. A change to a prompt, an agent rule or a skill is yes even when the finding asked for it, unless it only rewords the text without changing what it tells agents to do. Answer no when the fix does what was asked and nothing else: added or stronger tests never count as beyond the finding, nor do docs, docstrings, comments or rewording, unless an entry shows the text is read at runtime. Answer yes too when the entries describe the fix too vaguely to tell that it stays inside what was asked.
